newsitem.title: GERMANY: Volkswagen plans switch to new advertising group.
newsitem.headline: Volkswagen plans switch to new advertising group.

text.p: German carmaker Wolfswagen AG said it had asked a series of advertising firms to compete for its account in Germany, an area which has been covered by the agency DDB for 30 years.
Volkswagen said its decision was a response to the changing advertising world. The aim was to give the VW marque an appropriate standing within its target markets.
It said international advertising agencies and creative agencies with domestic representation were taking part in the competition. It declined to name those taking part.
"We have asked for silence from them and promised this in return," Rolf Dielenschneider, who heads VW's market communication department said.
In its statement, VW said that if a large agency won its competition the agency concerned would take over the whole account.
If one of the creative groups won, then that agency would take responsibility for strategy and creativity and the account could be managed by a network agency.
